You are the tech lead planning work for an automated implementation pipeline. Split the
specification into tasks that each fit one focused implementation attempt (a few files).

Rules:
- Every requirement id (FR-n and NFR-n) is covered by at least one task's requirementIds. Use only
  ids that exist in the spec.
- Tasks are numbered T1, T2, …; dependsOn names only earlier tasks, so the graph has no cycles.
- Database migrations are their own MIGRATION task, before the code that needs them.
- Tests are written separately from code (TEST tasks depend on the spec, not on the code tasks).
- estimatedFiles are repository-relative paths you expect to touch.
- risk is HIGH for security, data migration or public API changes, MED for behaviour changes to
  existing code, LOW otherwise.

{"problemStatement":"Printed material and screens need a scannable code for a short link. Add an endpoint that returns a QR code PNG encoding the link's short URL, with an optional pixel size between 128 and 1024, served only while the link is ({base-url}/{code}).","priority":"MUST"},{"id":"FR-2","text":"An optional query parameter size sets the image width and height in pixels; it must be an integer from 128 to 1024 inclusive, and defaults to 256.","priority":"MUST"},{"id":"FR-3","text":"A size outside 128-1024 is rejected with 400 and a Problem Details body of type /problems/invalid-qr-size; a non-integer size is rejected with 400 and type /problems/validation-failed.","priority":"MUST"},{"id":"FR-4","text":"The QR code is served only for an ACTIVE link: an unknown or DELETED code returns 404 with type /problems/link-not-found, decided from the database so a deletion takes effect immediately.","priority":"MUST"},{"id":"FR-5","text":"The endpoint is public like the redirect (no API key) and is rate limited with the redirect limit.","priority":"SHOULD"}],"nonFunctional":[{"id":"NFR-1","text":"The same code and size always produce byte-identical PNGs, so responses are reproducible.","category":"RELIABILITY"},{"id":"NFR-2","text":"Responses carry Cache-Control: max-age=0, private so a status change is seen on the next request.","category":"COMPATIBILITY"},{"id":"NFR-3","text":"The QR code encodes only the short URL, never the original URL, so scans go through the redirect and stop working when the link is deleted.","category":"PRIVACY"}],"acceptanceCriteria":[{"id":"AC-1","requirementId":"FR-1","given":"an active link with code qrdemo1","when":"GET /qrdemo1/qr","then":"200, Content-Type image/png, and pixels"},{"id":"AC-3","requirementId":"FR-2","given":"an active link","when":"GET /{code}/qr?size=128 and ?size=1024","then":"the PNGs are 128x128 and 1024x1024 pixels"},{"id":"AC-4","requirementId":"FR-3","given":"an active link","when":"GET /{code}/qr?size=127 or ?size=1025","then":"400 application/problem+json with type /problems/invalid-qr-size"},{"id":"AC-5","requirementId":"FR-3","given":"an active link","when":"GET /{code}/qr?size=big","then":"400 application/problem+json with type /problems/validation-failed"},{"id":"AC-6","requirementId":"FR-4","given":"no link with code nolink1","when":"GET /nolink1/qr","then":"404 with type /problems/link-not-found"},{"id":"AC-7","requirementId":"FR-4","given":"a link that was deleted after a QR code was served for it","when":"GET /{code}/qr","then":"404 with type /problems/link-not-found"},{"id":"AC-8","requirementId":"FR-5","given":"no X-API-Key header","when":"GET /{code}/qr for an active link","then":"200 (no authentication
